svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, the same as the FieldNode V-block (FND-DWG-102).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw a 20 mm slice off 60 x 40 mm bar; saw and file it to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 wide x 33 deep x 20 tall. The flat back goes on the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a 90 degree V on both 60 x 33 faces with a 45 degree square:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50.3 mm wide at the front face, point 7.8 mm from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw inside both lines and file to them; keep the V faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the V's front edges 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm 14 deep and tap M4 12 deep in the back face, 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of centre, half way up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M4 countersunk screws from the front of the plate. A

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 48.3 mm pole touches both V faces; 40 to 70 mm poles also seat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 48 mm tube it must not rock.
